articles.summary: MICHIGAN CITY, Ind., Dec. 22, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Horizon Bank, a commercial banking subsidiary of Horizon Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ GS: HBNC), announced today the appointment of Pam Zarazee as the Senior Vice President, Director of Human Resources. As Director of Human Resources, Zarazee will be responsible for leading Horizon Bank’s human resource function and will have oversight of the Bank’s talent management, employee engagement, and compensation functions. articles.title: Horizon Bank Announces Appointment of Senior Vice President, Director of Human Resources, Pam Zarazee
